title: fix(spec): validate action param defaultValue against the param's own value contract (#6970)
body:
Closes #6970

## Premise — re-verified on current `main`, still valid

The triage anchor `action.zod.ts:262` has moved to **`:320`** after ~24 merges, but the shape is intact. `ActionParamSchema.defaultValue` was `z.unknown().optional()`, while `validateActionParams` (`action-params.zod.ts:190`, ADR-0104 D2) validates the submitted bag through `valueSchemaFor({ type, multiple, options }, 'stored')`. Authoring and submit judged the same literal by different rules.

The consumer side independently confirms the direction. objectui `main`'s `serializeParamValues` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx`, after objectui#3930 landed 2026-08-09) stopped normalizing datetime params and names this card as the missing half:

> Deliberately NOT normalized here: an authored `defaultValue` written as a zone-less wall clock. That value is ambiguous metadata (whose zone?), the spec types it `unknown` so nothing rejects it at authoring time yet, and coercing it in the renderer would make it "work" in the UI while the identical literal still 400s from REST/MCP — the worst split to debug. It stays loud until the spec validates a param default against the param's own value contract (objectstack#6970).

## Design — reuse, not a second rule set

The triage ruling, quoted verbatim and untranslated:

> decision-free 的契约收紧 —— `defaultValue` 用参数自身 `type`/`multiple`/`options` 走同一 `valueSchemaFor` 校验是恢复 declared = enforced,不是新设计

A `superRefine` on `ActionParamSchema` runs the authored default through **the same `valueSchemaFor` call the dispatcher makes** — same function, same arguments, same form. No shape logic is duplicated or re-derived.

**Mode pick, by measurement.** `valueSchemaFor`'s second parameter is `ValueForm = 'stored' | 'expanded'` (`field-value.zod.ts:371`) — there is no `'submit'` mode. The dispatcher's own call is `'stored'` (`action-params.zod.ts:190`), so parity requires `'stored'`, and that is what the gate passes. `'expanded'` is the READ shape (`$expand` swaps an id for the record object) and would wrongly accept an embedded record as a default.

**Presence parity.** The dispatcher skips `null` / `''` / `undefined` before `valueSchemaFor` is ever reached. That predicate was file-local (`isPresent`); it is now exported as `isActionParamValuePresent` and consumed by the gate, so "what counts as a value to check" is structural parity rather than a remembered duplicate. Measured consequence: case 14 below — an empty-string default on a `datetime` is accepted at authoring precisely because the dispatcher accepts it too.

**What is deliberately NOT judged.** The gate answers only what the declaration itself can answer. This is not caution for its own sake: `action-params.zod.ts`'s own header states that field-backed params are "resolved to their effective value-shape inputs by the CALLER (the runtime, which holds the object metadata registry)" — that resolution has not happened at parse time, so an authoring gate that guessed would reject valid metadata.

| Situation | Why it stays open |
|---|---|
| no `type` | inherited from the referenced field at runtime; `validateActionParams` applies the same open default for an unresolvable type |
| field-backed, `multiple` unstated | arity is inherited; both arities accepted, element shape still checked |
| field-backed, no inline `options` | option set is inherited; `valueSchemaFor` degrades to free-form |
| `null` / `''` defaults | absent at submit, so not judged here either |
| `json` / `code` / computed types | the value contract is explicitly open (`z.unknown()`) |

## Reverse verification — direction predicted BEFORE the runs

Predictions recorded at **2026-08-09T16:31:59Z**, before any measurement. Predicted direction: a straight tightening (BEFORE accepts / AFTER rejects), **not** an inversion — `defaultValue` was `z.unknown()`, which accepts everything, so no pre-existing rule could have been over-reaching. Every row came out as predicted.

### Table 1 — BEFORE (pristine `origin/main`; fix removed with `git checkout`, never `git stash`)

Measured 2026-08-09T17:19:23Z.

| # | case | authoring | submit (dispatcher) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `datetime` + `'2026-08-10T15:00'` (card example) | **ACCEPT** | REJECT `invalid_shape` — expected an ISO-8601 instant with explicit zone |
| 2 | `number` + `'abc'` | **ACCEPT** | REJECT `invalid_shape` — expected number, received string |
| 3 | `select` + non-member of its own options | **ACCEPT** | REJECT `invalid_shape` — expected one of "gold"\|"silver" |
| 4 | `multiple: true` + scalar | **ACCEPT** | REJECT `invalid_shape` — expected array, received string |
| 5 | `date` + a full instant | **ACCEPT** | REJECT `invalid_shape` — expected YYYY-MM-DD |
| 6-9 | VALID default of each type | ACCEPT | ACCEPT |
| 10 | no `defaultValue` | ACCEPT | n/a |
| 11 | `json` (open contract) | ACCEPT | ACCEPT |
| 12 | no `type` | ACCEPT | ACCEPT |
| 14 | `''` on a `datetime` | ACCEPT | ACCEPT (absent) |

Rows 1-5 are the gap, verbatim: silent at authoring, 400 at submit.

### Table 2 — AFTER (fix applied)

Measured 2026-08-09T17:19:28Z.

| # | case | authoring | issue path |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `datetime` wall clock | **REJECT** | `["defaultValue"]` |
| 2 | `number` + `'abc'` | **REJECT** | `["defaultValue"]` |
| 3 | `select` non-member | **REJECT** | `["defaultValue"]` |
| 4 | `multiple` + scalar | **REJECT** | `["defaultValue"]` |
| 5 | `date` + instant | **REJECT** | `["defaultValue"]` |
| 6-9 | VALID default of each type | ACCEPT (unchanged) | — |
| 10 | no `defaultValue` | ACCEPT (untouched) | — |
| 11 | `json` open contract | ACCEPT (openness preserved) | — |
| 12 | no `type` | ACCEPT (same open default as the dispatcher) | — |
| 13 | field-backed, arity inherited | ACCEPT (deliberate non-judgment) | — |
| 14 | `''` on a `datetime` | ACCEPT (presence parity) | — |

The rejection names the param, its type and the offending literal:

```
Action param "start" (datetime): the default "2026-08-10T15:00" cannot satisfy this
param's own value contract — expected an ISO-8601 instant with explicit zone
(e.g. 2026-03-15T14:30:00.000Z). The dialog would PREFILL this value and the submit
would then be refused with that same message (ADR-0104 D2), for a field the user
never touched — so the 400 names the param but not this default, which is the real
cause. Write the default in the param's declared value shape, or drop `defaultValue`.
```

### The pins go red without the fix

Not assumed — measured both directions on the same file:

```
BEFORE (sources reverted to origin/main):  Test Files 1 failed (1)   Tests 11 failed | 13 passed (24)
AFTER  (fix restored):                     Test Files 1 passed (1)   Tests 24 passed (24)
```

Rejection pins assert issue **path + `code` + message shape**, never a bare `success === false` — a bare boolean cannot distinguish this rejection from the schema refusing the param for an unrelated reason. (This is a pure Zod parse, so there is no ADR-0112 error envelope to assert; the envelope rule applies to envelope-visible rejections, and saying so is more honest than manufacturing `code`+`status` fields that do not exist on this path.)

A parity test pins the ruling's actual claim — that authoring and submit use one rule set — by asserting the two agree on every case whose inputs the authoring side can resolve.

## Stock compatibility

**Already-stored action metadata carrying a nonconforming default keeps loading and keeps working.** Measured on the read path, not asserted:

- `DatabaseLoader.rowToData` (`packages/metadata/src/loaders/database-loader.ts:638`) replays the ADR-0087 conversion chain via `applyConversionsToStoredItem` and returns — **no Zod validation on the read path**.
- `MetadataManager.validate` (`packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager.ts:2218`) documents itself as a lightweight structural check, deliberately not the full Zod schema.
- Authoritative spec validation lives on the WRITE path (`protocol.saveMetaItem`) and is surfaced on reads as the advisory `_diagnostics` envelope — which now *reports* the nonconforming default instead of staying silent.

So the change is **loud at authoring, non-fatal at rest**: a stored nonconforming default does not break a running deployment, it becomes visible.

**Shipped metadata is unaffected.** Both action-param defaults the examples ship stay accepted, and no action-param defaults exist in `cloud` at all:

| Location | Param | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts:244` | `p_priority`, `select`, default `'normal'` | ACCEPTED — `'normal'` is in its own `options` |
| `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts:269` | `p_color`, `color`, default `'#7C3AED'` | ACCEPTED — `color` is in `STRING_VALUE_TYPES`, so the contract is `z.string()` |

Corroborated by the full suite: **9295 spec tests**, no fixture anywhere in the package carries a default this gate now refuses.

**No ADR-0087 conversion is owed.** Every conversion entry must be *lossless* (`packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` header). Rewriting a zone-less wall clock into an instant is not lossless — it would pick a timezone the metadata never declared, exactly the ambiguity objectui#3930 refused to resolve consumer-side. There is no mechanical "what the author meant". `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` passes.

**No `DEFAULT_CHANGES_BY_MAJOR` entry is owed.** That ledger (`packages/spec/scripts/lib/default-changes.ts` — note: *not* `migrations/registry.ts`) records declared `.default()` values moving; this change adds, removes and moves none.

**Changeset bump = `minor`, by repo precedent** for acceptance tightening on this very schema: `action-param-strict-unknown-keys` (reject unknown keys instead of stripping) is `minor`, and `action-param-inline-lookup-reference` (a `.refine()` that rejects a targetless lookup param at parse time — the closest structural analog) is `patch`.

## Generated artifacts — regenerated AFTER a build

`gen:api-surface` / `gen:export-origins` read the **built dist**, as `build-api-surface.ts`'s own header states ("Reads the built dist — run after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`"). Regenerating without building first silently dropped an unrelated entry (`JobRunOutcome` from `contracts.json`) that is present in source and in main's baseline — a stale-dist artifact, caught and discarded rather than committed. After a real build, the delta is 11 insertions and nothing else:

- `packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json` — the new `isActionParamValuePresent` export
- `skills/objectstack-{data,platform,ui}/references/_index.md` — new transitive deps (`field-value.zod.ts`, `action-params.zod.ts`, `errors.zod.ts`) now reachable from `action.zod.ts`

`content/docs/references` has **no** delta: the change adds no `.describe()` text.

## Sibling sweeps (read-only — reported, not fixed)

1. **objectui `resolveActionParams.ts:392`** — a field-backed param falls back to `field.defaultValue` (`rowDefault ?? param.defaultValue ?? field.defaultValue`). A FIELD default may legitimately be a runtime token (`'NOW()'`, `'current_user'`), which is not a value the dispatcher's contract accepts for e.g. a `datetime`. This gate cannot see it (the value is not authored on the param), and it is objectui's resolution path, not the spec's. Reported, not fixed.
2. **`cloud`** — no action-param defaults at all; only field defaults, many of them `'NOW()'` tokens on `datetime` fields (`packages/service-ai/src/objects/*.object.ts`). Unaffected by this change, and direct evidence that the field-level surface must not be tightened the same way.

## Gates — from `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, one by one

All pass: `check:generated --reconcile-only`, **`check:export-origins`** (new in the Type Check job today), `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:docs`, `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:react-blocks`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:spec-parsed-alias`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:meta-type-normalized`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, and `pnpm lint`.

Full `@objectstack/spec` suite: **356 files / 9295 tests passed**. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
